title: Ants Killed 15 Million Crabs on One Island by Spraying Acid

scenes.text: One island lost fifteen million crabs. The killers were ants.
Christmas Island's red crabs march to the sea by the millions. Nothing there eats them.
Then yellow crazy ants arrived. They don't bite. They spray formic acid into the crab's eyes.
Thousands of ants per square metre. The crab goes blind, stops moving, and the colony eats it.
By 2001 they'd killed up to fifteen million crabs. A third of the island.
The fix: a two-millimetre wasp, released in 2016, that cuts off the ants' sugar. The crabs are coming back.

description:
Yellow crazy ants on Christmas Island killed an estimated 10 to 15 million red crabs, a quarter to a third of the population, by spraying formic acid into their eyes and mouthparts.
The ants form supercolonies with thousands of workers per square metre (up to 2,254 foraging ants per square metre were counted). In December 2016 a 2 mm parasitic wasp was released to attack the scale insects whose honeydew feeds the ants; cutting off the sugar drops ant activity by about 95 percent within weeks.
Which invasive species has done the most damage where you live?
subject: yellow crazy ant
first_comment: The ants never actually eat the crabs alive; they blind them with acid, wait, then feed on the body. Which invasive species has done the most damage where you live?
